q: Consider the following statements: L. India retained the 40th position in Global Innovation Index among the top innovative economies globally as per Global Innovation Index (GII) 2023. II. As per WIPO Report 2022, India is ranked as 7th position in terms of Resident Patent Filing activity in the world. III. India improved its ranking to 60th position in 2023 from 79th position in 2019 as per Network Readiness Index (NRI) 2023 Report. IV. India secured 42nd position out of the 55 countries in the Global Intellectual Property Index 2024 as per the 12th edition of International Intellectual Property Index. Which among the above statements are incorrect?
options: I, II and IV (2) II, III and IV
Central Institute of Mining and Fuel Restarch (CIMFR)
Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (GCAR)
explanation:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (None of the above); it is added as option 5.
All four statements are correct (GII 2023 40th; WIPO 2022 resident filing 7th; NRI 2023 60th from 79th; IP Index 2024 42nd of 55), so the answer is 'None of the above'. The printed options here are garbled – they mix an answer code with three unrelated institutes (CIMFR, IGCAR, BHAVINI).

notes.text: - **WIPO Report 2022:** India **7th** in **resident** patent filing activity (later **6th** in both resident and non-resident filing, WIPO 2023).
- **Network Readiness Index 2023:** India **60th**, up from **79th (2019)**; NRI 2024 = **49th**.
- **International IP Index 2024** (US Chamber, 12th edition): India **42nd of 55**.

q: Which of the following is a correct pair of a super computer and its installed site in India?
explanation: AIRAWAT, the AI supercomputer, is at C-DAC Pune. PARAM Shivay is at IIT (BHU), PARAM Pravega at IISc Bengaluru and PARAM Ananta at IIT Gandhinagar, so the other pairs are wrong.

notes.text: > ⚠ Pairs trap (AEE): PARAM Shivay ≠ IIT Guwahati; Pravega ≠ IIT Kanpur; Ananta ≠ IIT Mandi → correct pair **AIRAWAT – C-DAC Pune**.
